_source: Verbatim Thai keys from pototype/gr.jsx GRList (L17-205) + forms.jsx GRCreateForm (L381-517) + the ds.jsx STATUS labels (L84-92). Kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so Thai never appears in .tsx/.ts source — same pattern as boq-strings.json. navGrList is the 'รับสินค้า (GR)' nav_i18n label (tn); every other value is a phrases key (tp) that has NO dedicated gr.* dict key (the gr.list*/gr.create* DICT keys cover the rest of the screen and are used via t()). statusApproved/statusCancelled/statusRejected are the ds.jsx STATUS.<status>.label strings the wire statuses map onto (received->approved badge per apps/api/src/routes/gr.ts; cancelled->cancelled; rejected label reused for the rejected-qty count).
